name: Helicopter_1
short_caption: The robot looks up and to its left with one hand raised, then looks up and to its right with the other hand raised, as if observing something overhead.
movement_description: The robot begins by tilting its head up and to the left while raising its left arm slightly bent with a loose hand towards its chest. After holding this posture briefly, it returns to the center before tilting its head up and to the right while raising its right arm in a similar fashion. Finally, it lowers both arms back to its sides and brings its head back to the level, forward-facing neutral position.
